newsitem.title: USA: Memorex Telex files for bankruptcy again.
newsitem.headline: Memorex Telex files for bankruptcy again.

text.p: Memorex Telex Corp and three affiliates filed for Chapter 11 protection in the U.S. bankruptcy court in Delaware on Tuesday.
The company previously filed for bankruptcy protection in 1992 and 1994.
According to court papers, Memorex Telex listed assets of $111.6 million and liabilities of $255.8 million.
Memorex, of Irving, Texas, supplies and services computer peripheral equipment, personal computers and computer media products, court papers say.
Also filing petition on Tuesday were the affiliates Memorex Telex of Puerto Rico, Tulsa Computer Products and Memorex Telex Services.
No other information about the bankruptcy is available at this time.
